verified_facts: OS Net station plan standard errors are generally better than 0.008m
OS Net station height standard errors are generally better than 0.020m
OSTN15 defines OSGB36 National Grid with OS Net
OSTN15 can be treated as effectively error free excluding GNSS positional errors
OSTN15 agreement with old triangulation stations is 0.1m rms
OSGM15 provides regional vertical datum transformation
OSGM15 Great Britain height standard error is 0.008m
OSGM15 stated error excludes GNSS heighting error
transform accuracy is not terrain-model accuracy
geoid error must remain separate from LiDAR RMSE
GNSS error must remain separate from OSGM15 model error
datum transformation must be recorded in candidate provenance
quality_effect: Separates OS geodetic transformation error from terrain, LiDAR and GNSS errors so millimetre geoid figures cannot be misreported as parcel-height accuracy.
